patches.reason: mistressSet7/8/9 (Paris, Phoenix, Snow) were never written: the author commented out their names, the nine-name spanker menu, and their saved settings, and mistressArray holds six names, so the menu index stays below 6 and pick_mistress below 7. The calls are dead code that fails as undefined functions; comment them out in the author's own style.

Three author errors. The settings menu saves Corner add, max corner, Corner end, Lines add and max lines under OTK.*, while the start reads DareOTK.* (and max lines from OTK.maxLines), so these settings were lost or crossed on the next start: use the DareOTK. prefix of every other key of the unit. Chloe, Courtney and Krissy read the integer counter DareOTK.met.<name> with loadBoolean, which is never true for a number, so they never recognised a returning player: read it with loadInteger, as the other mistresses do. setImageInfo draws getRandom(4)+1, so its Courtney case (5) never ran: draw getRandom(5)+1, as the identical setImageDare does.
